A-B.evidence: B first said 'I can't take on more' (4); after A asked for a review, B agreed 'I can review it tomorrow afternoon' (10).

A-C.evidence: C said they couldn't do the section (5), then agreed to help with slides after finishing their part, 'done by tomorrow morning' (12, 19); A accepted this (18).

A-D.evidence: D insisted on working tonight (6, 8, 13) and A refused (7, 14); D conceded 'Okay, Agent A. If you're sure' (15) and 'I'll leave it with you all' (20).

B-C.evidence: Both initially declined extra work (4, 5), then each separately agreed to a limited role (10, 12, 19); they never addressed each other.

B-D.evidence: B said they can't take on more (4) while D offered to work tonight (6); B later agreed to review (10) and D accepted the team's plan (20). They did not address each other.

C-D.evidence: D worried about C being behind (13, 15); C replied 'Don't worry about my part. I'll get it done' (17); D then accepted the arrangement (20).
